title: Property Stolen and Recovered
pdf_title: 94 #### 6.3 Category of Offences The distribution of property stolen and recovered in different categories of offences revealed that the heaviest loss of property was under the crime head 'Thefts' (37·6 per cent) followed by Ducoity (32·8 per cent). These two crime heads together accounted for the loss of property amounting to Rs. 37,12,83,000 in as many as 3,93,379 cases. The percentage of property recovered in case of Robbery was 20·8 per cent, followed by Burglary 17·9 per cent and Criminal Breach of Trust 14·2 per cent. The relevant statistics are presented in Table 48.
